name: Bastion rimE38
concept: The Sentinel: more Guards than anyone, a Counter on nearly every attack, and blocks that win the next round too. Repulse (his own Guard) Staggers a Pressure it beats; the Aegis special knocks down; the Final Bastion Super leaves them Dizzy. His Pressures punish the Converts his Guards push them into.

cards.name: Repulse
cards.flavour: Turn the blow aside and step in.

cards.name: Recall
cards.flavour: Cover up, then bring back what you need.

cards.name: Charge
cards.flavour: Cover up and build the bar.

cards.name: Aegis
cards.flavour: Plant the shield: whatever hits it goes down.

super.name: Final Bastion
super.flavour: Once a game: the wall that leaves them reeling.

notes: v19 tuning: HP 38. v19 test (8 November 2026): Counter icons only on Pressures (Mark), played with the grey cap (9). Moved from the v18 file: every Convert loses Counter; Edge Jab, Sonic Cutter gain it. Rules v18, 8 November 2026 (afternoon), Mark: better attacks, Knockdown on Lockdown (throws usually knock down) and HP 36. Edge Jab 17, Shield Bash 15 (Starter, Linker, Counter), Rim Shot 14 (Build 4, chip 1); Lockdown On hit: Knockdown. Against the 7 November Benchmark: 52.8% (54.0%, 51.6%; two seeds of 400); 45.2% without the speed changes (variants/bastion-36-attacks.json). As drafted that morning (HP 32): about 30%, variants/bastion-as-drafted.json.
